summary: The complete legal domain ends at 16 characters, while the required output can vary from one partition to exponentially many. That bounded, output-sensitive domain cannot provide an honest unbounded scaling axis for separating table construction from unavoidable output work.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The verified source constraint is 1 <= s.length <= 16.

replacement_checks.evidence: The current algorithm fills exactly n(n + 1)/2 palindrome-table entries. Every explored backtracking edge chooses a palindromic substring and has at least one completion through single-character cuts, so search and leaf copying are bounded by the total emitted partition work L.

The source-fidelity-verified examples cover alternate cut structures and the one-character minimum; black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition.
